verdict.rationale: Versioning or rollback of user-defined automations is a fair question for a search platform with configurable rules and integrations, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence that Meilisearch lets users version, review, or roll back any automation or rule configuration. The versioning-policy item covers engine release SemVer, not user automations, and Dynamic Search Rules have no documented history or rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
